context: Futures are higher overnight as softer inflation data cools rate hike bets, with Micron's earnings beat and AI news lifting tech stocks ahead of Accenture's report.

items.why: S&P 500 and Nasdaq futures rose after a softer core PCE inflation reading.
items.sentiment: Traders see softer inflation cooling rate hike bets.
items.judge_note: Both headlines link the PCE report to futures rally and cooling hike odds; h332 explicitly cites the Core PCE surprise as the cause, h354 confirms traders flipped to a hold after the PCE report.

items.why: Kashkari said inflation pressures remain a concern for the Fed.
items.sentiment: Kashkari signals the Fed is not done tightening.
items.judge_note: Both headlines from different publishers (Barron's, Reuters) confirm Kashkari views inflation pressures as a concern requiring further Fed action, signaling more tightening ahead.

items.why: Accenture is set to report Q4 earnings this week.
items.sentiment: Shares rose about 3% ahead of the report.
items.judge_note: Both headlines confirm Accenture earnings are anticipated this week (Thursday/Oct 1), and both GuruFocus and TradingKey confirm shares rose roughly 3% (3.5% and 3.18%) ahead of the report.
